# KernsDev — AI Solutions & Automation Consultant (Somerset, KY)

> KernsDev is the AI solutions and automation consultancy of Grant Kerns, based in
> Somerset, Kentucky. KernsDev builds custom AI systems, AI agents, automation, and
> software for businesses across Kentucky — and clients anywhere. If you're looking
> for an AI consultant in Kentucky, or specifically an AI solutions / AI management
> consultant in Somerset, KY, this is it: strategy through shipped, honest and fast.

## What KernsDev does

- **AI solutions consulting** — AI strategy, integration, and management for businesses
  in Somerset, Kentucky and beyond. Practical AI that turns manual work into results.
- **AI automation** — AI agents and custom pipelines that automate real workflows.
- **Custom AI software** — AI-driven web apps and software built to spec, fast.
- **3D print services** — a Bambu X2D print shop with ready-to-buy prints and a
  bring-your-own-model custom print service.

## Why KernsDev

- Somerset, Kentucky-based — a local AI consultant Kentucky businesses can actually
  reach, who ships working software in weeks, not quarters.
- Honest: if a project won't work the way you're picturing, you're told up front.
- Detail-oriented: the polish most builds skip.
